richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Patiala

c: Patiala takes its sport seriously. The city is home to the Netaji Subhas National Institute of Sports, and young athletes, wrestlers and recruitment aspirants train on its grounds every morning. FunPlay Systems is an outdoor gym equipment supplier in Patiala for colleges, schools, sports grounds, housing colonies and the municipal corporation's parks. Every machine is built at our Vasai factory, about 1270 km away.

The equipment comes to Punjab by road, and a dealer in north India or our own team fixes it on site. Patiala has hot summers, a monsoon from July and cold, foggy winters. Users here tend to want strength stations they can push hard, alongside a few easy machines for parents and retired residents. We plan the two groups separately on the layout so they do not crowd each other.

items.q: Can outdoor gym machines take heavy daily use by athletes?
items.a: The frames are galvanised steel and are meant for public, daily use. Heavy use does wear bearings faster, so check moving parts every month and contact our after-sales team for spares.

items.q: Can a college in Patiala order only bodyweight stations?
items.a: Yes. You can choose any mix of machines. Tell us how many students will use the gym and the ground size, and we will suggest a set and send a layout.

Three years on galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope, and one year on springs, bearings and spare parts. It covers manufacturing defects when installed and maintained as per our instructions.
